    Before you buy: Raw milk and listeria

    From milking to cheese

    Swipe to see the five steps.

    Milking

    The milk arrives fresh and is checked before use.

    Curdling

    Cultures and rennet turn it into curd.

    Moulding

    The curd goes into moulds and drains its whey.

    Salting

    Dry salt or brine, depending on the cheese.

    Ageing

    Each piece is turned and cared for as long as it needs.

    Before you buy

    Raw milk and listeria

    If you are pregnant, over 65 or immunocompromised, avoid raw-milk cheeses unless cooked above 70 °C for at least 2 minutes. Ask your doctor before eating fresh, soft-rind or blue cheeses. For young children, ask your paediatrician.

    Allergens

    All contain milk. Ask about other possible ones, such as egg (lysozyme). Boards with sides may include tree nuts.

    Storage

    Keep in the fridge, wrapped in cheese paper. Take it out a while before serving and respect the date on the label.

    Source: AESAN listeriosis leaflet (Spanish food safety agency, in Spanish)
